<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. The formula that best matches this mass and the observed ~16 % M+1 isotope peak (consistent with ~14 C atoms) is C₁₄H₁₁O₆. This fits the mass within a few millidaltons and explains the isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H11O6</final_answer>
